purpose: Adapters for Yale, Harvard vertebrate histology, Korean type-slide repositories, Turkish nematology and Chilean donation records added in 07I.
guards: Collection project pages may establish scale and physical rehousing even when item cataloguing is incomplete.
Repeated literature depositions may establish a repository node, but never manufacture an aggregate slide count from accession-number examples.
Government project reports describing loss, reorganisation and new preparation must preserve those events separately.
Donation news establishes a transfer event and recipient collection, not an unstated item count.

adapters.promotion_rule: Capture historical scale, physical curation, archival-cabinet transfer and future database plan; seek Peabody item endpoint separately.

adapters.institution_scope: Nakdonggang National Institute of Biological Resources
adapters.promotion_rule: Preserve institutional identifiers and taxonomic deposit events as item anchors; aggregate count remains null until an official repository export is found.

adapters.institution_scope: Nazife Tuatay Plant Protection Museum / Central Research Institute for Plant Protection
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture existing preparations, documented losses, reorganisation, newly prepared taxa and catalogue creation as separate lifecycle events.

adapters.institution_scope: Museo Nacional de Historia Natural de Chile Entomology
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture donor, project, collection date/geography and recipient; leave physical count null unless accession records provide it.
